review.item_premise: The constructor owns the complete private startup and SCRAM handoff inline, inside its future-aware span. It alone acquires the placeholder driver outside the private storage module; configuration remains secret-owned. A process semaphore bounds outstanding derivations, without reading observation to choose results.
